children: RideNow reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $244.3 million, down 13.1% year over year, and a net loss of $13.9 million. Gross profit was $65.5 million, while Adjusted EBITDA fell to $5.3 million from $12.3 million a year earlier. The company attributed lower retail volume in part to its rollout of a transparent pricing model.
Revenue was $244.3 million, down 13.1% from $281.0 million in the prior-year quarter.
Gross profit was $65.5 million, compared with $76.0 million a year earlier.
Operating income was $4.2 million, versus $9.4 million in the third quarter of 2025.
Net loss was $13.9 million, compared with a net loss of $4.1 million; GAAP diluted loss per share was $0.36, versus $0.11.
Adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 million, down from $12.3 million in the prior-year quarter.
Retail powersports unit sales declined 16.6% year over year: new units fell 17.9% and pre-owned units fell 13.7%.

The company said its August rollout of the RideNow Clear Price model, intended to align with FTC pricing guidance, affected retail volume amid competition from dealerships using different pricing practices.
Management reported signs of a fourth-quarter rebound and expects Q4 Adjusted EBITDA to exceed Q3, despite the company’s typical seasonal trend.
RideNow completed a tuck-in dealership acquisition in Tallahassee, Florida.

The company refinanced its senior secured term loan with a $220.0 million facility maturing in September 2031 and said discussions were advanced for a new $50.0 million asset-based revolving credit facility.

title: RideNow Reports Q3 Revenue of $244.3 Million and Net Loss of $13.9 Million
